title: Workshop camera control panel
changes: Grouped Views, Rotate, and Zoom controls with responsive wrapping.
Minimum 40-pixel button heights and visible keyboard focus.
Side and Close presets show selected state, clearing when the angle changes.
Preserved camera, focus, fullscreen, and inspected motion behavior.

validation.note: Initial run had one fixed-length-markup assertion failure and three timeouts. Replaced the brittle assertion with DOM inspection. Suite retry passed 226/227; the remaining timeout passed its isolated rerun (268ms). The initial accessibility suite passed all 28 tests.

publication: Local only; no commit, push, or deployment
